title: British Museum
visualBrief: Specific complete mapped British Museum complex: irregular original gallery wings/open southern forecourt, mapped Ionic colonnade/tapered fluted shafts/volute capitals/native overhead entablature and triangular relief pediment, south steps, varied gallery rooflights/brick side wings and modern northwest service-conservation masses. Great Court retains its mapped curved triangular lattice/translucent glass shell, public court floor and Reading Room stone drum/arched upper windows/pale dome/small lantern. Only mapped museum components are replaced; surrounding Bloomsbury terraces and streets remain native. No copied lettering, banners, artworks, crowds or private texture; furnished collection galleries/Reading Room interior, hidden plant and future masterplan proposals excluded.
